observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: outdoor paved plaza at the Memorial ACTe museum, public event
observation.dancers: large group of mixed gender and age, including adults and children; mostly women
observation.formation_and_space: large, loose, shifting circle formation; dancers move freely within the space
observation.posture: upright torso, knees slightly bent, weight shifts between feet
observation.footwork: rhythmic stepping, shuffling, and tapping; precise footwork is obscured by distance and camera movement
observation.arms_and_hands: arms move fluidly, often raised or used to manipulate skirts; hands are generally open
observation.hips_and_torso: subtle hip movement and torso swaying, following the rhythm
observation.levels_jumps_turns: mostly upright, occasional small jumps and turns
observation.costume_and_props: casual clothing, many women wear long, colorful skirts; some wear headwraps
observation.cannot_infer: exact weight transfer, intricate footwork, and specific hand gestures are difficult to discern due to the wide camera angle and distance from the dancers

signature_moments.what: dancers in the circle sway and manipulate their long skirts in rhythmic patterns
